Reference / calendar

calendar#

Immutable Gregorian calendar views.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let august = MonthDates(origin: YearMonth(year: 2026, month: 8));
august.size();       // 31
august.first()::Calendar::day; // 1
august.last()::Calendar::day;  // 31

Description#

Immutable Gregorian calendar views.

MonthDates contains only dates belonging to its month:

CalendarMonth divides a month into complete seven-day rows. A row may contain dates from adjacent months:

let grid = CalendarMonth(
    origin: YearMonth(year: 2026, month: 8),
    first_weekday: Weekday.monday,
);
grid.first().first(); // 2026-07-27
grid.last().last();   // 2026-09-06

ISO weeks always run from Monday through Sunday; IsoWeek refuses a week its year does not have when made. A calendar grid whose complete seven-day span would leave Date's supported years 1..9999 is refused when it is walked or measured, instead of returning partial weeks. Year(2028).leap() tells a leap year.
